name: replay-endpoint
title: Add an admin endpoint to replay stored events
body:
## Motivation

When an event fails to apply it stays `failed` forever. Acme keeps retrying it, but every retry has an `id` we already have, so it is acknowledged as a duplicate and never reaches `processEvent` again. The usual case is a `refund.created` that lands before its `payment.succeeded` (PAY-198): last week support had to fix three refunds by hand in the database. Ops needs a way to re-run an event once the cause is fixed, without touching SQL.

## Changes

- New `POST /admin/events/:id/replay`. It is an operator action and is meant to sit with the other admin routes behind `x-admin-key`; it is mounted under `/admin` from `app.ts`.
- `EventService.replay` puts the event back to `received` and runs it through the existing `processEvent`, so a replay goes through exactly the same transaction (payment change, outbox message, status) as a live webhook. No second code path to keep in sync.
- Replays are recorded for audit: a migration adds `replayed_at` and `replay_count` to `events`, and both are returned as `replayedAt` / `replayCount` on `GET /admin/events` and `GET /admin/events/:id`.
- If the replayed event throws, the error is logged and the event is closed out instead of staying in the failed list; the endpoint answers `{ ok: true }` once the replay has run.
- Pulled the duplicated row mapping in `list` and `get` into `toStoredEvent` while adding the new fields.
- README documents the endpoint, when to use it, and a curl example.

## Testing

- New `app.inject` test: a processed `payment.succeeded` is replayed, the endpoint returns 200 and the event shows `replayCount: 1`, still `processed` with no error.
- Replayed one of the stuck refunds from PAY-198 against a copy of the production database locally; the payment moved to `partially_refunded` as expected.
- Existing tests unchanged and passing; `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` are green.

## Open questions

- During an incident we might have hundreds of failed events. Should we add a bulk `POST /admin/events/replay?status=failed` now, or keep it one id at a time so an operator looks at each event before replaying it?
